## Downloads

**RouterDeck desktop app** (recommended on a computer)

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 | `RouterDeck-Windows-x64-Setup.exe` |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `RouterDeck-macOS-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS Intel | `RouterDeck-macOS-x64.dmg` |
| Linux | `RouterDeck-Linux-x64.AppImage` or `RouterDeck-Linux-x64.deb` |

First launch: Windows → *More info → Run anyway*. macOS → *System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway*.
Linux AppImage → `chmod +x` then run.

**RouterDeck Connect** (small helper for using RouterDeck in the browser or on phones): `RouterDeck-Connect-*`.

**Browser extension**: install from the [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/routerdeck/egfnlpdojhpdhakgcifhiadchbanddjj) (Chrome, Edge, Brave).
Manual packages: `routerdeck-chrome-edge-*.zip` (store upload), `routerdeck-firefox-*.zip`,
`routerdeck-extension.zip` (load unpacked).

Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
